card.text: White star in Ophiuchus, seen almost equator-on, flattened by its fast spin.

introduction.text: Rasalhague spins so fast that its equator swells to 2.86 solar radii while its poles sit at 2.39. It is drawn that shape, 14.9 parsecs away.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: Measured colour, with hot poles and a cool equator from a fit that fixes β; its tilt is disputed.
